recap.text: Tally is a surly, smelly, hairy, gnome-like Protector who scrubs toilets and cooks food in safe rooms. Tally tells of a corporation that saps planets dry and leaves them without air. In a Peruvian Taco Bell, a level twenty-one Protector named Sebastian brushes a cat's hair with his own brush.

beats.headline: The protector behind the counter
beats.text: Magical, gnome-like, hairy, and posted to watch over safe rooms. They do everything from scrubbing the toilets to cooking the food; they are surly, they are smelly, and they never wash their hands. The first one they meet is called Tally.
beats.gist: Tally is a surly, smelly, hairy, gnome-like Bopca who scrubs toilets and never washes their hands.

beats.headline: They came, and Tally went
beats.text: Tally comes out from behind the counter to watch the premiere at the booth, and he does not like last season. The other corporation broke people into groups and told them their loved ones would be safe if they killed the others. The loved ones were safe, he says, and not safe; that company saps a planet dry and leaves it without air. Borant at least gives people a chance. He was never a crawler. Sometimes they offer to take people instead of mining a world. They came, and he went. Very long ago.
beats.gist: Tally watches the premiere and says Borant gives people a chance unlike the other corporation.

beats.headline: Sebastian and the hairbrush
beats.text: The Peruvian Taco Bell has a Protector named Sebastian, level twenty-one, and a cat with a charisma of forty-one walks in and he is lost. The man gets a Peruvian beer and a T-bone steak. The cat gets the Protector: he sits beside her through the third episode brushing her hair with one of his own brushes, which he gave her after her third shower.
beats.gist: A cat with a charisma of forty-one gets a level twenty-one Protector named Sebastian.
